meta.bit_reading_note: each position runs one compiled circuit on its chain (order); its outcome is the classical bits circuits.<name>.measured_clbits, the last listed bit first, as the ideal's keys are written
meta.description: Kickoff 43, Job 2: four public circuits (XOR_5, BV_10, Mul_13, Sym_9), each compiled without and with qubit reuse (Tapering, after QR-Map) and routed on a line, each placed two ways: by the map's chain search (Amendment A1's score, the gate-weighted sum of |1 - k|) and by Qiskit's calibration-based layout; 16 cells, 5 interleaved copies, 80 circuits, 20000 shots each, counts. The circuits are not in this release: their licence is unclear. Their sources, SHA-256, structure and exact ideal outputs are.
meta.bit_order: Qiskit bitstrings, rightmost character = classical bit 0

fixed_before_the_data.score: Amendment A1: the gate-weighted sum of |1 - k| over the chain's couplers
